verdict.rationale: Otter documents its own Public API in a help-center article: base URL https://api.otter.ai/v1 with API-key auth, retrieving channels, conversations, transcripts, audio, action items, insights and outlines. Pricing and the enterprise blog corroborate that it exists. But the documented surface is retrieval-only, limited to Enterprise workspaces, and published only as a prose article. missing for 10: write/control endpoints that actually drive the product (e.g. starting recordings or creating meetings), availability outside Enterprise, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (openapi.json returns 404), interactive reference or sandbox, version lifecycle docs, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Otter's Public API provides programmatic access to retrieve channels, conversations, transcripts, audio, action items, insights, outlines, and workspace details
Custom Integrations with Otter's Public API: Otter meeting data connects to any system, including niche CRMs and proprietary platforms
